newsitem.title: UK: RMC squeezed higher after Cazenove comment.
newsitem.headline: RMC squeezed higher after Cazenove comment.

text.p: Shares in British building materials group RMC Plc jumped on Tuesday as buying following an earlier Cazenove recommendation created a severe shortage of stock in the market, dealers said.
The stock was up 43-1/2p at 980 by 1451 GMT.
"Cazenove was talking the stock up this morning and a few buyers forced the stock up," said one dealer. "One of two market makers have been round the market looking for stock."
Cazenove maintains a policy of not publicly commenting on any of its stock recommendations.
Today's rise in the stock extended a rally since the building materials group hit a 27-month low of 875p on January 14. Trading volume was a modest 613,109 shares.
